derivation: neuter of a derivative of G5442 (φυλάσσω);
def: a guard-case, i.e. "phylactery" for wearing slips of Scripture texts

occurrences.text: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
